text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- River blindness disease has been detected in Mozambique for the first time, by a Maputo university medical faculty team financed by the World Health Organisation.

- Construction begins on Tuesday of a 26 km (16 mile), $3.0 million fence around the Maputo elephant reserve in southern Mozambique. The fence is part of U.S. businessman James Blanchard's plan to create a 236,000 hectare (590,000 acre) tourist paradise in the Matutuine district.
